text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Agnes Digital and I are at a
ramen
restaurant, when...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-I finally got the chance to come here!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyah! R-R-Rob Roy! At a ramen
restaurant! What
a rare sighting!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... page 257, shoyu... ramen...
here it is.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: E-excuse me... Ummm... Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: I've got two orders of shio ramen!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hmmm?! It seems Rob Roy is in a pickle!
choice_data_list: Doesn't seem like they heard me.
Doesn't seem like they heard me, huh.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Could you get her order over
there,
please?! I swear I'll never ask you
for anything
else ever again!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa, that's quite a promise! I'll get
on it
right away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Agnes Digital's help, Zenno Rob
Roy
manages to place her order.
However, not long
after...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, it looks like it's best with tons
of
pepper... Oh? There's none on the
table...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Special delivery coming through!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whooosh!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what was that just—oh! There's
pepper now!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Mission accomplished! Please, take your
time and
savor the ramen...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Stumbling upon Rob Roy enjoying ramen... this is the result of building good karma.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um... Digital?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whaaa?! Rob Roy! Um, I... uh!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Thank you... for helping me out earlier.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um uh, I-I-I-I'm so sorry! Really, I
shouldn't
have stuck my nose in!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! It's thanks to you that I was
able to eat
the ramen I'd been looking
forward to.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
This book I'm reading has a scene where
the main
character eats ramen the night
before a race...
The restaurant in the
book is modeled after the
one we just
visited.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I thought that if I could eat the same
thing as the
main character, maybe I
could run like her too...
Although it's
probably just wishful thinking.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-yes?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: There's something I must tell you...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You work hard day in and day out, all in
an
innocent chase for victory, as if
appealing to
some higher power.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
In my heart, you are already the main
character!
There's nothing more I could
ask for than to be of
help to you!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Th-th-that makes me so happy! Just... so
very
happy...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Th-th-that makes me so happy! Just... so
very
happy...
choice_data_list: You're one of the main characters too, you know.
You're one of the protagonists too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I only spoke what was honestly on my
mind.
choice_data_list: You're one of the main characters too, you know.
You're one of the protagonists too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I see. Anyway, I have to go, but
let's eat
ramen together sometime.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Let's... do that?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hwaaah! No way! Did one of my oshis
just invite
me to ramen?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The image of her glasses fogging up as
she blew
on her ramen is still fresh in my
head!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And to think I've been offered the chance to behold her person again enjoying another steamy bowl! My mouth is watering already... Drool!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Love for Umamusume bursts from within
Agnes
Digital, just like always!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whargh?! Wh-what are you saying? I'm
nothing
more than a supporter, a mere
pleb!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
But I... I don't really stand out either.
Hehe... We
may be birds of a feather.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! Us? B-birds of a feather?!
Th-th-th-that's
far too immodest a
thought!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm so sorry! You must not like being

compared to someone like me...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No! I'm overjoyed that I can... sh-share
the same
feelings as.... y-y-y-y-y-y...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed by conflicting emotions,
Agnes
Digital completely loses her grip!
